annotations.title: Audit Local B2B Websites, Owner Emails & Cold Pitches

description:
Audit local SMB websites for technical, SEO, pixel, and DNS deliverability weaknesses, then extract owner emails and factual cold-pitch copy.

Parameters: Supply at least one source (websiteUrls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId + datasetField, sourceRunId, or presetChambers; omitting all returns 0 items at $0). agencyPreset tailors scoring and copy, dedupStoreName + dedupMode persist 16-shard KV snapshots for skip_seen or watch_diff modes, and onlyWithEmail, onlyWithWeakness, or minPitchScore filter before billing. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Writes KV dedup shards and optional webhookUrl payloads, isolates per-site WAF/timeout errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $4.50/1K leads ($0 on WAF, filtered misses, or skip_seen repeats).

Use for local agency prospecting; do not use for SaaS SOC 2 audits (use audit_saas_trust_center) or Meta/DTC ad audits (use audit_meta_ads_advertisers).

agencyPreset.description: Agency service vertical used to weight pitchPriorityScore and tailor coldEmailSubject, coldEmailIcebreaker, and linkedInDm.

chamberCategoryKeyword.description: Optional category keyword filter for Chamber directories (e.g. "dental", "plumbing", "restaurant", "roofing").

chamberDirectoryUrls.description: Optional custom ChamberMaster / GrowthZone directory URLs.

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset (default keeps standard structured schema).

customAgencyOffer.description: Optional 1-line agency value proposition deterministically woven into coldEmailBody ($0 AI).

datasetField.description: Optional explicit field name to read from datasetId/sourceRunId items when chaining non-standard datasets.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL (e.g. from Google Maps Scraper) to chain leads directly, preserving no_website VIP leads.

dedupMode.description: When dedupStoreName is set: skip_seen skips previously audited leads at $0; watch_diff detects website/DNS buying triggers.

dedupStoreName.description: Optional Apify Named Key-Value Store (16-shard compact snapshots) for weekly skip_seen ($0 repeats) or watch_diff buying-trigger tracking.

dnsFallbackOnBlocked.description: Default false skips WAF-blocked (403/429) sites at $0. Set true to run out-of-band DNS-only audit on live blocked domains.

enableContactPageFollow.description: Follow up to 1 internal /contact, /about, or /team page when the homepage lacks an email.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

maxItems.description: Maximum total leads to audit and save (1-2,000).

minPitchScore.description: Minimum 0-100 pitchPriorityScore required to save and bill ($0 below threshold).

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only leads where an email is found ($0 otherwise).

onlyWithWeakness.description: When true, skip polished websites with 0 detected weaknesses at $0.

presetChambers.description: Optional verified US Chamber of Commerce city presets to auto-collect paying local businesses.

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV, TSV spreadsheet rows, or newline-separated company website URLs/domains.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or Console URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId and streams leads.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTP/HTTPS webhook URL to receive audited leads JSON on completion.

websiteUrls.description: Optional list of up to 2,000 local business website URLs to audit, e.g. ["https://ddofoods.com"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, sourceRunId, or presetChambers is provided.

name: audit_local_b2b_websites

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Audited local B2B business leads with 8-point website weaknesses, 11-query DNS deliverability grades, owner emails, and custom cold pitches.

cmsPlatform.description: Detected CMS (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, etc.).

inboxType.description: Inbox risk classification: b2b_direct, general, cs_ticket_queue, or none.

leadPriority.description: Deterministic priority tier: VIP_HOT, WARM, or NURTURE.

outreachStatus.description: Copy safety gate: ready or manual_review_required.

primaryEmail.description: Prioritized owner or business email (null when none or quarantined).

siteStatus.description: ok, slow, no_website, unreachable, http_error, bot_protected, or bot_protected_dns_audited.

websiteUrl.description: Audited website URL (or null if no_website).
